Subject: Greener sheets for upcoming studio editions

More makers have been asking for lower-impact stock, and our presses are now ready for it. From May 8 onward, our print shop accepts recycled paper for regular print jobs. To make sure your chosen weight feeds cleanly and holds ink well, artists should bring a sample before booking a run.
